intro.title: Recruitment process
intro.description: FGV Quant brings together FGV students who want to learn quantitative finance by doing. Details of the next recruitment process haven't been announced yet. This page will be updated as soon as they are.

how.title: How it works
how.description: Stages, deadlines and criteria will be published here once the league announces the process.
how.pending: The recruitment stages haven't been announced. Nothing here is an estimate: we'll publish only what the league confirms.

who.title: Who can take part
who.body: The league is for FGV students interested in quantitative finance.
who.pending: Eligibility requirements (programs, semesters, prerequisites) haven't been announced yet.

items.a: No date has been announced yet. Once the league announces it, we'll publish it here and on our channels.
The league is for FGV students. Eligibility requirements will be published together with the process details.

items.q: Do I need to know how to code?
items.a: Prerequisites haven't been announced yet and will be published with the process. What we can say is that the league uses problem-based learning (PBL), with technical training in programming and data.

items.q: How will I know when applications open?
items.a: Follow FGV Quant on Instagram and LinkedIn: that's where announcements will be posted.

notify.title: Get notified when it opens
notify.description: Follow the league to find out when the recruitment process is announced.
